# The generated entry records and package layouts carry the build tool's ABI
# version; the public runtime contract is available without creating an isolate.
[short] skip
[compiler:gccgo] skip
go build -isolate-report report.json -o check$GOEXE ./host
grep '"metadata_version": 1' report.json
grep '"api_version": 1' report.json
grep '"determinism_version": 1' report.json
exec ./check$GOEXE
stdout '^isolate contracts passed$'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/contracts
go 1.26
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs

import "isolate"

//go:isolate
func Check() error {
 _, err := isolate.Call(1, []byte("ok"))
 return err
}
-- host/main.go --
package main

import (
 "fmt"
 "isolate"
 "time"
 "example.org/contracts/jobs"
)

func main() {
 h, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Check)
 if !ok || h.MetadataVersion()!=1 {panic("missing versioned handle")}
 if isolate.CurrentContract()!=(isolate.Contract{Metadata:1,API:1,Determinism:1}) {panic("unexpected runtime contract")}
 p:=h.ProgramWithHandle(func(h isolate.Handle){
  if err:=h.Invoke(func(...isolate.Value)error{return nil},func(...isolate.Value)error{return nil});err!=nil {panic(err)}
 })
 if p.MetadataVersion()!=1 {panic("program dropped metadata version")}
 now:=time.Unix(0,0)
 i,err:=isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program:p,Deterministic:true,InitialTime:&now,TimerOp:2})
 if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 if err=i.Start();err!=nil {panic(err)}
 select {
 case c:=<-i.Commands():
  if string(c.Payload)!="ok" {panic("wrong result")}
  c.Reply(nil,nil)
 case <-i.Done():panic(i.Wait())
 }
 if err=i.Wait();err!=nil {panic(err)}
 fmt.Println("isolate contracts passed")
}
